Whole user PMU window L1 refills: hot / cold / signed paired difference
64 trials per group; 3072 raw windows + 1536 paired differences. Panel y ranges differ; all tails retained.
Black bars: arithmetic means; green band: P/S D mean gate [1.5, 2.5]. E is a sentinel, never subtracted. CNTFRQ = 19.2 MHz; no core-cycle conversion.
